title: Section 600.1 – Retitle the Informational Note in Section 600.1 “Informational Note No. 1” and add a new
officialText:
Informational Note No. 2 at the end of Section 600.1 to read as follows:
Informational Note No. 2: All plastic materials to be used in the manufacturing of electric signs shall be in
accordance with the Chapter 26 of the New York City Building Code. Outdoor signs shall comply with Appendix H
of the New York City Building Code.
